decisions.reason: Confirmed a nonfatal citation gap: F4 states an explicit split absent from the cited Statement (although proved in supplier step 4.1). Repaired F4 and locally derived the split from the spectral expansion, nonnegative altered weights summing to one, countable-mixture closure and distinct orthogonal rank-one states. No claim or physical qualification was weakened.

Confirmed a nonfatal citation-domain gap: F3 and the ray lemma give the trace identity only for nonzero vectors. Added the already-authored rank-one calculus as a direct mathematical premise and F6, whose Statement (b)-(c) covers all vectors including zero. Step 3.1 now cites F6. Scaling, normalization, injectivity and all clauses remain valid under Countable Choice.

Confirmed a nonfatal missing citation: the complex-number definition expressly delegates field structure to thm-complex-numbers-form-a-field. Added that published, read-only supplier as a direct premise and cited it in L4; step 2.1 now derives a0=0 from distributivity, excluding a zero inverse. The unchanged Statement refuted is false and the zero-vector witness refutes all its assertions.

Confirmed a nonfatal citation misattribution: the matrix-product definition supplies no trace rule. L4 now states only matrix multiplication and identity, and the mixed-state purity is derived from the two eigenvalues 1/2 using the already-declared purity lemma, explicitly restated in L3. The projection calculation gives purity one and rank one. Also repaired the digest-confirmed vector/ray type wording: u is a unit vector and [u] its ray.

Confirmed nonfatal source-fidelity defect in the bibliography note. Read Binney and Skinner Section 6.3, printed pp.121-124 (PDF pp.128-131), especially p.122 and equations (6.61)-(6.64): they model uncertainty over alternative states with probabilities and distinguish it from a coherent superposition. Replaced the reversed attribution with that faithful description. The remark body correctly separates mathematical hypotheses, adopted state assignment and empirical neutrality.

False positive: the supplier heading is Statement refuted, not Statement. Its Counterexample steps 1.1, 2.1 and 2.2 prove that zero has no unit representative, normalization is undefined, and its rank-one operator has trace zero. The remark accurately summarizes that refutation and separates model semantics from observation. Each other paragraph matches the inspected Example interfaces and preserves the absence of measurements and the deferred radiation interpretation. No edit is justified.
